image_description: A still life composition featuring three white ceramic coffee cups on saucers arranged on a wooden table. One cup is upright in the center, one is tilted on its side to the right, and one is in the background. Scattered coffee beans are present on the table and saucers. To the left, there is a burlap sack and decorative pinecones/acorns. In the background, out-of-focus glass vessels are visible. Text at the bottom reads 'Cups And Beans' and 'project26c • photography'.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'Cups And Beans' and 'project26c • photography' is legible but exhibits slight softness and irregular kerning typical of AI-generated text, lacking the crisp vector sharpness of real typography.
Several coffee beans lack distinct anatomical grooves (the central cleft) and appear as smooth, brown ovals. Some beans seem to merge slightly with the wood texture or shadows.

The glass vessels in the background have warped geometries; the rims are unevenly thick, and the vertical lines wobble, indicating a failure to maintain rigid geometric structure in out-of-focus areas.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object class is indeed 'cup' and distinguish from bowls or mugs based on handle/body ratio.
To verify the handles are fully connected loops and rims are closed curves without melting or fusion artifacts.
To ensure the cups sit correctly on the saucers/table with proper contact shadows and no floating elements.
To rigorously assess the legibility and character correctness of the generated text.
To detect subtle texture smearing or repetition in the small detailed objects.

focus_areas: Circular symmetry of rims and saucers
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'tilted' cup on the right. Does the liquid inside (if any) or the shadow behave physically correctly? Check if the coffee beans have the characteristic central groove or if they are just smooth blobs. Verify if the text at the bottom contains any nonsensical characters despite being mostly legible.
